name: Renfa
source:
Race: Human
Role: Adventurer & Hero

The descendant of the "hero" who sealed Karin away. When she recognizes Karin on one of her trips into to town, she confronts her. Karin tells her to come challenge her in the dungeon. When defeated, she expects Karin to kill her, but Karin does not, and tells her to look at things through her own eyes, and not just blindly follow legends.
